opening.argument: The material promotes unusually high daily returns through flash-loan arbitrage, claiming "$2000/Day Passive Income on Uniswap" and "Make 4+ ETH Passive Income Daily" while requiring at least 0.3 to 0.35 ETH to perform the arbitrage successfully. It then directs viewers to deploy a smart contract and "send one ether to this address," with further transaction and flash-loan fees required. The speaker reports, "We started at 1 ETH and now we are actually at 1.3 ETH." That reported increase supports the promised-return framing, but the displayed wallet balances differ and the source does not independently establish the transaction outcome or whether funds could be recovered.
